page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory performance, with the Passmark memory score placing in the top 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1699.39 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 69.91 GB/sec. CPU performance is generally average, with a Passmark CPU score of 36598.86 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 13329.0. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong text generation speeds of 304.16 tokens/sec using a small 135M LLM model, while medium 7B model inference runs at 18.87 tokens/sec.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g7.8xlarge offers stable resource density for enterprise applications. The absence of bundled local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a structural tradeoff for disk-heavy tasks. This instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, including database operations, web serving, software compilation, and moderate machine learning inference tasks.
